calculation_steps: From E'<=0, E(0)<=34 a²/5+51/20000000 using g_i<=21/20 and positive housing initial energy.
From radial/edge/mount positive storage, bound |s_i|<sigma, |e_ij|<epsilon, |H-A|<delta with strict rational inequalities.
For a<=1/25 choose sigma=3/20,epsilon=1/4,delta=7/20; endpoint strut>(1-eps)/2-delta=1/40; median identity gives opposite strut>1/40.
For a<=3/100 choose sigma=1/9,epsilon=1/5,delta=4/15; every strut>2/15.
Gram: reference eig(1/2,1/2,(7+3sqrt5)/8), use shared energy to bound ||DeltaG||_F²<206656471/855000000<(123/250)².
Normalize Gram by G0^-1/2: relative operator norm<123/125; all eigenvalues positive, each oriented volume ratio between (2/125)^(3/2) and (248/125)^(3/2), signs preserved.
Positive member/strut length margins and bounded velocities over finite intervals exclude vector-field singularities; global solution by local ODE continuation.
Preserve original alpha=.1 energy-sublevel witness and note chosen rational-majorant failure just above trial thresholds is not a dynamical counterexample.
